dct_description_sm: Notes on browsing: Under the 'Files' tab, toggle between 'Table' and 'Tree' view. Table view lists all files sorted in alphanumeric order. Tree view presents the files organized into folder structure according to flight date (Year_Month).

This dataset contains scanned oblique aerial photographs taken from a small plane over Long Point, Ontario, Canada. Fourteen flights were conducted from 1985 to 1992. Three flights were conducted in 1985 (April 1985; October 1985; December 1985), including before and after an intense storm event that occurred on December 2, 1985, two flights in 1986 (April 1986; November 1986), three flights in 1987 (June 1987; July 1987; December 1987), two flights in 1988 (May 1988; September 1988) and one flight each in 1989 through 1992 (August 1989; June 1990; May 1991; September 1992). The images are scanned from Kodachrome slides using a Magnasonic Model FS50 scanner at 22 megapixels resolution.
dct_title_s: Scanned oblique aerial photographs for Long Point, Ontario, Canada [1985 - 1992]
